name: Meetings
description: Send Recall.ai bots to meeting URLs and stream transcripts and summaries into Thymer.
instructions: Meetings is a global plugin — it does not create or own a collection on install. Open Plugin: Meetings from the command palette. Setup walks you through the three things Recall.ai needs (a Recall key, a Claude key, and a small free bridge). Then open Collections: create a Meetings collection, or add one you already have (a calendar's Events collection, say) and point Meeting URL at the property holding the meeting link. Add a link to a record and run Meetings: Join now.
author: @akaready
